title: Action
description: A single execution event in which an Actor invokes a Skill, in service of a Task, at a point in time.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

rationale.description: The Actor's stated reason for the Action, recorded for explainability.

idempotency_key.description: Key that makes a retried Action safe to repeat.

inputs.description: The inputs passed to the Skill.

concerns.description: The Work Item the Intent, Task, or Action is about.

performed_by.description: The Actor that carried out the Action.

fulfills.description: The Task the Action was performed for.

approved_by.description: People who confirmed the Action, Plan, or Result before it took effect. Required whenever the effective Assurance Level or a Policy calls for human confirmation.

has_confidence.description: The Confidence attached to this Result, Observation, Action, or Plan.

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Extension property, namespaced with a prefix.

ref.description: Identifier of an entity: an IRI, a compact IRI such as aow:AL2, or an id relative to the document base.
